We need to produce a correct tool call. Let's construct target SMILES as described. Use the first precursor but replace C(=O)O with C=O. The first precursor SMILES: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". Replace "C(=O)O" with "C=O". That yields: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". Let's use that.

Now call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with that SMILES, functional_groups_broken=["carboxylic esters"], functional_groups_formed=["aldehydes"], limit 5.
